purpose: Shared component pins and truthful readiness status for public intake, isolated PusingCuk execution, and four-repository synchronization.

authority_model.Founder-OS: Durable decisions, constraints, recovery context, curated knowledge index.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-core: Runtime truth, authorization, operational data, AI orchestration, and evidence.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-public: Public-safe web experience; never a second backend or private knowledge store.
authority_model.pusingcuk: Canonical language, specification, interpreter/native runtime, registered .cuk rules, and conformance.

capabilities.native_rule: One deterministic registered .cuk rule; exact source commit and source hash are pinned.
capabilities.founder_knowledge: Bounded lexical ranking over a curated 20-document public-safe multi-repository index; validates immutable source URLs against repository, path and source commit; returns source authority/evidence/claim status and uses deterministic validated citation footers. This remains lexical retrieval, not vector search.
capabilities.local_llm: Ollama provider adapter source; default model qwen3:4b; no hosted LLM API key required for local inference.
capabilities.runner_boundary: Authenticated local HTTP gateway; fixed budget rule allowlist with source hashes, strict request/output limits, and mandatory immutable Docker image ID. Container has network disabled, read-only root, all Linux capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, non-root UID, 64 MiB memory, 0.5 CPU, 16 PID cap, 2 CPU-second ulimit, and host-enforced timeout/output cap.
capabilities.model_training: Not implemented; PusingCuk is a language/runtime, not a trained LLM.
capabilities.production_runner: Docker sandbox image and authenticated HTTP runner are CI-tested, but the runner remains local-only unless deployed on a protected host. CORE verifies source commit, program hash, runtime build commit, sandbox mode and immutable image ID before marking rule_succeeded.
capabilities.repository_freeze: Not approved until migration parity, auth/data/audit preservation, backups, restore and rollback are verified.
capabilities.additional_pusingcuk_rule: budget.sufficiency.v1 is registered in the local runner and tested against six cross-runtime fixture cases inside the Docker sandbox. CORE executes it only when PUSINGCUK_RUNNER_URL and PUSINGCUK_RUNNER_TOKEN are configured.
capabilities.cross_repository_sync: CORE CI fetches integration/system-lock.json from main in Founder-OS, CORE, PUBLIC and PusingCuk, then requires schema version, sync_id and parsed JSON content to match the checked-out CORE lock. This is an automated drift detector, not a claim that every repository commit SHA should be identical.
capabilities.public_intake: CORE public-intake Edge Function v3 supports POST intake and GET redacted status/evidence lookup; strict payload validation, body cap, honeypot, HMAC-hashed IP rate limit (5 requests/hour shared by submit/status), UUID idempotency, private RLS ledger, append-only events, and verified sandbox callback. The browser has only a publishable key; service-role credentials remain server-side.

Founder-OS decision history and recovery context are preserved with provenance.
All callers, Edge Functions, workflows, schedules and public contracts are inventoried.
Backup/restore, rollback and security review have been rehearsed and explicitly accepted by the Founder.
